executable_probe.result: All 14 membership samples reproduced using actual frozen Topic and ExecutorBindings modules. Both true and false needs_attention values projected unchanged; severity absent from projected wake record.

source_contracts.finding: Default patterns come from ExecutorBindings; options can override patterns. matching_fresh_event? checks topic membership and integer identity, plus executor-topic watermark, not needs_attention or severity. Non-executor matches project then enqueue.
needs_attention is preserved as strict boolean metadata; severity is not included. Metadata presence is distinct from routing eligibility.

CI and GitHub budget pauses emit separate non-attention wait topics. Other working-to-paused transitions emit ticket.<id>.agent.attention.paused-<cause>, needs_attention true. Resuming emits agent.unpaused and the previous pause attention topic with .resolved appended; neither matches current default patterns.
Text still says 24 bindings while module has 26. Example relay jq expression selects eight alternatives. This downstream relay filter is not a second daemon event-bus routing implementation.

Workspace alert relay explicitly excludes remote-worker/workspace-less central alerts and names recurring server-side watch as its backstop. Its limited scope is documented, not proof that central alerts have no surface.
